svg.title: GraphCodeRAG system architecture
svg.desc: End-to-end architecture showing ingestion pipeline, dual storage, hybrid retrieval, and generation layers

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Tell me more about SWE-bench Lite dataset')
sendPrompt('How does the file scanner work in GraphCodeRAG?')
sendPrompt('How does Tree-sitter AST parsing work for code chunking?')
sendPrompt('How does the code chunker extract functions and classes?')
sendPrompt('How are import edges and call edges extracted?')
sendPrompt('How does embedding generation work for code chunks?')
sendPrompt('How is Neo4j used as a knowledge graph for code?')
sendPrompt('How does Chroma vector database store code embeddings?')
sendPrompt('How does graph traversal find multi-hop dependencies?')
sendPrompt('How does vector similarity search work for code?')
sendPrompt('How does the LLM generate answers from retrieved context?')
sendPrompt('Explain MRR and Recall@K for code retrieval')
sendPrompt('What is Pass@k metric for code generation?')
sendPrompt('How to build Streamlit frontend for code assistant?')
